detail.longDescription: # Mathematics # Riemann # AHM # Statement # Anthropic # Research "Autonomous computer programs that investigate deep mathematical questions are now instruments of power in scientific research, and scientific power enables other types of power that can directly threaten human lives. This power is now concentrated in the hands of AI companies that seem increasingly untethered from the interests of human society. We believe that AI corporations urgently require democratic oversight." From the "AHM Statement on the Announced Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis": https:// proofsandprompts.com/2026/11/2 1/ahm-statement-on-the-announced-proof-of-the-riemann-hypothesis/
